note: Example for hitl/console: copy to deploy/units.json and make it yours. units: the FCs this project uses, by their AUTOPILOT_VERSION uid (the console's check shows the full uid of an FC that is not listed; ./runbridge param-readback prints it in autopilot_version). role 'aircraft': the FC in the airplane, switches between its hitl and flight recipe (a pair: same firmware and SD files, deploy/flight_switch.py --pair). role 'hitl_only': a bench FC, never switched to flight (flight null). hitl / flight: recipe folders in deploy/. title: the page's title; takeoff_m: the automatic takeoff's height in the simulation. The uids and recipe names below are placeholders.
